name: SVS - State of Power
description: States with similar or very close power are paired together for cross-state battles that include castle sieges, troop combat, and changes to the presidency.
duration: About 2 weeks: 2 days of matchmaking, 6 days of preparation, then the battle phase and the field triage phase.

phases.name: Matchmaking
phases.description: 2 days. The system pairs states by power. Day 1 checks power and day 2 reveals the opponent.

phases.name: Preparation
phases.description: 6 days. Players earn points through tasks, and State Points depend on Furnace level. The state with the most points wins and gets the State Bonus.

phases.name: Battle
phases.description: The cross-state portal opens at 10 UTC and the Sunfire Castle battle begins at 12 UTC. The winning state alliance can appoint the Supreme President. Attacks are limited by Furnace level difference.

phases.name: Field Triage
phases.description: Revive lost troops (30% to 90% recovery) and receive 20 Rebirth Tomes to help allies.

rewards.note: Reach the highest personal points grade on a preparation day or in the battle phase to earn 1 State Medal. More medals unlock more rewards.

tips: Coordinate with alliances in your own state instead of fighting them.
Use shields if you are not online when the portal opens, to reduce losses.
Your Furnace level affects how many State Points you contribute.
